accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:matched-frontier and the two open-ended questions
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: All proved rate and honest-length targets are conditional on one fixed certified signature Sigma; exact minimax equivalence, cross-signature adaptation, and shortest simultaneous-region optimality are explicitly reserved as open content.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The closed statistical headline is an oracle upper frontier over P_Sigma, not an asserted exact frontier or adaptation result beyond that fixed class.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4 states that truncation and continuity can identify the lag coefficient when the inverse score is large, explains that finite treatment support removes that concern, and the following section gives a root-G plug-in estimator for the finite-support case.
Theorem 2.1 gives the irregular-panel large-sample result at sqrt(N h_N), and equation (29) gives an MSE-optimal bandwidth proportional to N^(-1/3).

source_verification_receipts.version: Econometric Theory First View, published online 7 January 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies stayers and slow movers in panel data, derives asymptotic theory and standard errors, and develops higher-order bias reduction; it does not claim multi-lag Hankel-stratum adaptation.

The paper defines Hankel determinantal rings via minors of Hankel matrices, records maximal-minor reductions and the lower-minor singular locus, and proves rational-singularity results rather than probability-tail laws.
The Main Theorem gives degree- and codimension-dependent upper bounds for volumes of tubular neighborhoods of real algebraic varieties.

source_verification_receipts.version: Annals of Mathematics 152(1), 2000 text reproduction of the published article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper stratifies polynomial numerator--denominator integral families into algebraic sets with explicit algebraic integral-size expressions; it is machinery for, not a result on, causal Hankel-score tails.
The article studies moments of ratios with robustness to large trimming bias and develops scalar bias correction and inference.
The article develops adaptation theory for nonparametric confidence intervals, including expected-length lower-bound tools, rather than a panel same-signature least-favorable construction.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add one worked rational-box or rational-polytope signature that displays the normal-link certificate, both local-zeta indices, and the resulting finite oracle grid from primitive treatment-history coordinates.

Promote the same-signature Le Cam/Assouad construction into a subsequent explicit theorem target, beginning with the K=0 scalar and K=1,T=5 branches to test whether the selector-distance index is genuinely lower-bound attainable.

State a practical sufficient condition for the original-coordinate Whitney class in the motivating newspaper-count design, such as a bounded smooth distributed-lag response surface on the declared dose polytope.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 on the fixed-signature tail-atlas and oracle-frontier kernel, retaining same-signature minimax lower bounds and feasible joint adaptation as separately scoped solve targets.
